name: Running between the wickets: recorded Yes and No, and the setting is off by default
message: Running between the wickets: one recorded Yes! and one recorded No! (the player's voice from the press conference) instead of the phone's voice, and Settings > Running between the wickets is now off by default. Needs the audio step.

ops.find: echo "== Trimming the silence off the auctioneer's clips =="
ops.replace:
echo "== Downloading the running calls (Yes! and No!) =="
# One recorded "Yes!" and one "No!" in the player's voice (the press conference's player voice, generated by the web app's press_tts_generate
# endpoint), at /_cdn/press/run_yes.mp3 and run_no.mp3, stored in the pack as run_yes.mp3 and run_no.mp3. RunScreens.kt plays them when you decide a run.
# The silence ElevenLabs leaves before and after is cut, so the call is heard the moment you swipe.
run_count=0
for id in run_yes run_no; do
  run_count=$((run_count + 1))
  fetch "$BASE_URL/_cdn/press/$id.mp3" "$SCRATCH_DIR/$id.mp3"
  if [ -f "$SCRATCH_DIR/$id.mp3" ] && command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if ffmpeg -nostdin -loglevel error -y -i "$SCRATCH_DIR/$id.mp3" -vn \
        -af "silenceremove=start_periods=1:start_threshold=-42dB:start_silence=0.03,areverse,silenceremove=start_periods=1:start_threshold=-42dB:start_silence=0.03,areverse" \
        -ar 44100 -ac 1 -b:a 96k "$SCRATCH_DIR/$id.trim.mp3" && [ -s "$SCRATCH_DIR/$id.trim.mp3" ]; then
      mv "$SCRATCH_DIR/$id.trim.mp3" "$SCRATCH_DIR/$id.mp3"
    else
      rm -f "$SCRATCH_DIR/$id.trim.mp3"
    fi
  fi
done
echo "Running calls listed: $run_count"

echo
echo "== Trimming the silence off the auctioneer's clips =="

if (timedOut) say(line) else call("run_no", line)
                conclude(completed, false)

ops.find: "You decide the runs" (the default) or "The computer decides the runs" (as before). Part one of the feature: the user's own batting decisions and the partner's calls; the voices are the phone's own.
ops.replace: "The computer decides the runs" (the default, as before) or "You decide the runs". Part one of the feature: the user's own batting decisions and the partner's calls. **"Yes!" and "No!" are recorded** (patch 127: one clip each, `run_yes` and `run_no`, in the press conference's player voice, generated through `press_tts_generate`, fetched by `tools/fetch_audio.sh`, played by `SoundEngine.playPress`); the phone's voice says everything else, and says "Yes!" / "No!" itself if a clip is missing. A time-out ("Time is up. No run.") is spoken by the phone. The voice was chosen by description and not heard by the assistant.
